BLAST Bounty 2027 Season 1 ranking on November 2nd, 2026
This ranking is our prediction of how the BLAST Bounty 2027 Season 1 invitations will look like. The ranking is looking 6 months back from November 2nd, so time decay is accounted for. It includes unfinished events that will end before November 2nd. We have removed teams from organizations that already have a higher-ranked team qualified.

Valve ranking of Counter-Strike Teams

Ranking follows Valve's model for ranking Counter-Strike teams.

How is the ranking calculated?

The ranking takes into account the accomplishments of teams starting from the chosen date (in Copenhagen timezone), inclusive of that day and extending back over the previous six months.
